question.text:
The colour change of an indicator HIn in acid base titrations is given below

Which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: In a strong alkaline solution colour Y will be observed
In a strong acidic solution colour Y will be observed
Concentration of  <math><mtext>I</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>n</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>  is higher than that of HIn at the equivalence point
In a strong alkaline solution colour X is observed

solution.text: It is an acidic indicator therefore will remain in ionized form in strong alkaline solution (opposite ion effect) so it will show the colour due to  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msubsup></math> which is colour Y.
